title: Changing only the case or punctuation of a part's own number saves
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test at the test location only, with capital letters and a hyphen in its part number.
  • Make sure no other part at the test location has a number that matches part A's, ignoring upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the part A row.
  2. Replace the Part Number with part A's part number in lower case.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Type part A's part number in lower case in the Search box.
  5. Click the part A row.
  6. Replace the Part Number with part A's part number in capitals, without its hyphen.
  7. Click Save.
  8. Type that number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 2:

  • Part Number holds the lower-case number.

Step 3:

  • The save goes through: no "already exists at this location." message appears, and the window closes.

Step 4:

  • One row is listed: part A, renamed to the lower-case number, with its description unchanged.

Step 5:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 6:

  • Part Number holds the number without the hyphen.

Step 7:

  • The save goes through with no "already exists at this location" message.

Step 8:

  • One row is listed: part A under its number without the hyphen.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description)

  • S7-N5c: “The check never counts the part being saved. Changing a part's number only in upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods or spaces, for example FF-5507 to FF5507, saves when no other part at the location matches it.”
  • S7-N5b: “S7-N3 and S7-N4 apply when a part is created and when its part number is changed. Saving a part with its number unchanged is never refused by them, even when the location already holds a part whose number matches it.”
  • Key Decisions: “A new part number already stocked at the location is refused, ignoring case and punctuation. This check stops a second copy of a part at one location. It runs when a part is created or its number is changed, never when a part is saved with its number unchanged. It is separate from linking, which stays exact.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
